topic: Losing a storage unit to a lien auction vs calling the facility first (Franklin vs Bess)

scenes.narration: Miss two payments and your storage unit can be auctioned off. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench beside an auctioneer's gavel and a storage unit stamped LIEN SALE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Franklin and Bess both store family heirlooms in rented units.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man franklin and woman bess loading heirloom furniture into storage units, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Money gets tight and both fall two months behind.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two overdue notices stamped TWO MONTHS BEHIND on storage doors, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The contract allows a lien sale after written notice.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a rental contract clause reading LIEN SALE AFTER WRITTEN NOTICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Franklin never updated the address on his rental agreement.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an old apartment mailbox stuffed with unread storage notices, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Notices go to an old apartment and are never read.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a returned envelope stamped NO LONGER AT THIS ADDRESS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His grandmother's furniture sells at auction for ninety dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an auctioneer selling a heirloom cabinet, a bid card reading NINETY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bess calls the facility the day she misses a payment.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bess on the phone with a storage manager, calendar circled, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She arranges partial payment and pauses the lien clock.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a payment receipt stamped PARTIAL PAYMENT ACCEPTED beside a paused clock, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Then she empties the unit and closes the account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bess carrying the last box out of an empty storage unit stamped CLOSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One lost irreplaceable heirlooms. One lost nothing at all.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, an empty auctioned unit, and heirlooms safe in a living room, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Update your address, and call before the lien starts. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a banner reading CALL BEFORE THE LIEN, kids comic book illustration
